read.description: false: the functions list could not be read (an error scoped `functions` says why); items is then empty and total/omitted are null - not a project without functions

state.description: 2nd gen state or 1st gen status, as Google reports it

omitted.description: Functions left out of items by maxItems

unreachableRegions.description: Regions gcloud could not reach: their functions are missing from items and the sync's partition is failed

ambiguousIds.description: Function ids found in more than one region (up to 50): in items, but not synced as resources
